latest_cos_commentary.headline: Iconex (M2S Group) manufactures thermal receipt paper and linerless labels for QSR order identification, claiming adoption by several top hospitality chains without naming them.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Peripheral/consumables overlap only (receipt paper, kitchen labels); not a competitor to any core Genius software or payments line, and typically a complementary supplier regardless of which POS platform a restaurant runs.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No major 2026 leadership or ownership change was found beyond confirmed M2S Group ownership; the company continues its usual trade-show presence (FSTEC 2026).
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not a competitive-displacement conversation; Iconex is a consumables supplier that can coexist with any POS platform choice.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Accuracy/cost-reduction statistics and the "Top 7 hospitality chains" claim are unverified vendor marketing language with no named customers or independent source.
